table.name: Case

row.name: id

row.name: case_number
row.comment: user-facing investigation identifier

row.name: created_at
row.comment: ISO-8601 UTC

table.comment: Decision 28: case -> run -> source -> raw_record -> observation

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid4 - the only non-deterministic id

row.name: id_case
row.comment: decision 28

row.name: input_path
row.comment: the operator's --input root (decision 24: run grain)

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(path) - decision 38: never the hash (2c); diffable across runs

row.name: path
row.comment: the archive as opened; UNIQUE

row.name: cd_sha256
row.comment: central-directory hash (reuses sqlite/integrity.py fingerprint_zip), INDEXED column - same archive bytes twice = a query/finding (GROUP BY cd_sha256)

table.name: Run-Archive link

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_run, id_archive) - run metadata (decision 38)

row.name: skipped
row.comment: decision 38: opt-in skip, RECORDED - eligible only when a previous run parsed the same cd_sha256 with the same preset set (key+version+definition_digest)

table.comment: Decision 38: one run opens many archives, one archive appears in many runs; every encounter recorded, skips included

table.name: Run-Preset link

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_run, id_preset) - run metadata (decision 39)

table.comment: Decision 39: every preset SELECTED for the run, even when it yields no observation; run.settings_json carries every operator arg/option

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5 over paths, never the fingerprint

row.name: input_file_path
row.comment: INPUT SOURCE (decision 24): the outermost artefact mATLAS opened

row.name: inner_path
row.comment: chain-inclusive path inside containers (outer.zip!inner.zip!db.sqlite) - R10

row.name: subunit
row.comment: table / sheet / query inside the file

row.name: source_tier
row.comment: primary (acquisition parsed) | secondary (a tool's export parsed)

row.name: reported_data_source
row.comment: REPORTED DATA SOURCE (decision 24, source grain): where a SECONDARY tool REPORTS the data originally lived (UFDR/tool manifest device path) - its claim, not our observation. ENFORCED NULL for a primary acquisition (pipeline drops it and warns): there input_file_path already IS the verified location. Projection falls back to the input source

row.name: fingerprint_sha256
row.comment: hash match = finding, never a merge

row.name: raw_json
row.comment: the complete source row, verbatim - incl. every context party

row.name: recovery_source
row.comment: OUR OWN L0 finding: fine origin (wal/journal/freelist/freespace), ordered by descending reliability so it doubles as the confidence signal. NO 'live' member: an in-place row was recovered from nowhere, so this is NULL when recovery_state is live and a populated cell IS the 'recovered' signal. Preset-free (L0); the OBSERVATION columns of the same names are what projects - decision 48

table.name: Preset

row.name: id
row.comment: content key uuid5(key, version) - decision 27

row.name: key
row.comment: stable preset key

row.name: definition_digest
row.comment: decision 40: sha256 of the canonical preset definition - catches edits without a version bump; skip eligibility compares digests

table.comment: Decision 27: one file matching several presets = one source, many observations; the preset is a property of the READING

table.name: Observation

row.name: id_raw_record
row.comment: every claim comes from a record

row.name: id_preset
row.comment: decision 27: which reading produced this observation

row.name: id_entity
row.comment: the TARGETED entity - the one under investigation, and the one the flat CSV names on its line (UNIQUE, owned). Further placed parties = further observations on the same activity

row.name: id_bearer_entity
row.comment: the POSITION BEARER (UNIQUE) - the entity whose position the spatial arm states: a CDR antenna, an ANPR camera, an ATM terminal. Fixed by entity_link (decision 55, table CHECKs): = id_entity for subject, another entity for party, NULL for unknown (no placeholder is ever minted). Storage orders by whose position it is; the projection orders by who is under investigation, so the flat view joins Entity twice

row.name: id_activity
row.comment: NULL for a standalone observation (GPS fix)

row.name: id_spatial
row.comment: nullable: a login has no place; UNIQUE = owned corner

row.name: id_temporal
row.comment: nullable; UNIQUE = owned corner

row.name: entity_link
row.comment: ENTITY ARM LINK (decision 55) - what role does the targeted entity play? CHECK: EntityLink = subject (holds its own position: it IS the bearer) | party (another entity holds it) | mentioned | unknown (no bearer). Preset-stated enrichment; feeds no digest

row.name: spatial_link
row.comment: SPATIAL ARM LINK (decision 55) - how does the observation use the position? CHECK: SpatialLink = measured | registered | served | seen | used | stayed | located | searched | shared | cached | unknown (an open list). No precision (that is horizontal_accuracy_m) and no negation (that is temporal_link). NULL when there is no spatial expression (table CHECK)

row.name: temporal_link
row.comment: TEMPORAL ARM LINK (decision 55) - how is the interval referenced? CHECK: TemporalLink = throughout (box P) | at_least_once (diamond P) | never (box not-P) | not_throughout (diamond not-P) | unknown. The ONLY place a negation can be stated (modal duality would otherwise let one fact be written two ways); on an instant only at_least_once / never are written. The fourth link, to the source, is id_raw_record + id_preset - no column

row.name: recovery_state
row.comment: live | recovered - TWO values only (decision 48). TIER-GATED: from OUR parsing on a primary source (copied from raw_record), from the preset i.e. what the TOOL reports on a secondary one; never blended. This is the column that PROJECTS. It replaced `deleted`, whose question no source answered separately from this one. EXCLUDED from the L1 digest: how a record was obtained is provenance, not identity

row.name: recovery_source
row.comment: wal | journal | freelist | freespace | unknown - NULL when the state is live. Same tier gate and same digest exclusion as recovery_state

row.name: source_label
row.comment: the one per-claim provenance field (decision 24)

row.name: input_record_id
row.comment: preset-mapped human locator back to the source record; LOCATES one record

row.name: source_record_uid
row.comment: preset-mapped source key (a tool Item ID); GROUPS the rows one record fanned out into. Preset-resolved, so it lives here and not on the preset-free raw_record; NULL = the engine-generated raw_record_id is used. Feeds no digest

row.name: observation_content_hash
row.comment: digest scoped to the preset's reading of this file; repeats legally, never a key

row.name: spatiotemporal_entity_hash
row.comment: file-independent L1-only digest (R5): overlapping disclosures converge here as a finding

table.comment: linked_entity dropped (decision 17): the attributed party is entity.concerns. UNIQUE(record,preset,ordinal) = the §2a guard + decision 27

table.name: Entity

row.name: id
row.comment: occurrence, never merged

row.name: identifier
row.comment: NORMALIZED at ingest (E.164, lowercase email, ...); NULL for a purely typed mention ('the device'). Convergence = GROUP BY (identifier_type, identifier)

row.name: raw_identifier
row.comment: decision 21: the identifier AS WRITTEN, verbatim - the entity corner's L1 residence on the row itself

row.name: identifier_type
row.comment: which normalization: msisdn | imei | email | plate | account | other | none (decision 17)

row.name: type
row.comment: what the thing IS: device | person | vehicle | camera | case | ...

row.name: concerns
row.comment: the attributed party, fixed at parsing (absorbs linked_entity / decision 12); excluded from both digests

row.name: concerns_origin
row.comment: operator_param | preset_mapped - who specified it

row.name: concerns_uid
row.comment: decision 22: digest of the case-folded/stemmed concerns ('A. Moreau' / 'moreau a.' group together); derived, never a key, excluded from digests

table.comment: Decision 17: one lean row. Normalization + stemming rule-set versions recorded once per run (matlas_meta)

table.name: Activity

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(raw_record_id, activity_ordinal) at ingest; cross-record merging = analysis-time Activity-record link rows

row.name: kind
row.comment: call | message | trip | transaction | incident | ...

table.comment: One real-world happening AS ONE RECORD describes it at ingest. A call = 2 observations sharing an activity only when BOTH legs are placed

table.name: Analysis

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_observation, method)

row.name: method
row.comment: algorithm + version - a re-run ADDS rows, never mutates

table.comment: Decision 19: THE analysis-layer table - the tool's verdict ABOUT an observation, never inside it. CSV projects the current method's row

table.name: Spatial Expression

row.name: referential
row.comment: encoding / CRS of the raw value: epsg:4326 | geohash | mgrs | address | place_name | cell_ref | asset_ref | region

row.name: spatial_source
row.comment: mechanism (the V1 position_source): GNSS | WiFi | cell | fused | ... - symmetric with temporal_source

table.comment: HEADER only (decision 15): the raw values live in Spatial Component rows. For detector records the instrument IS this expression (the camera id is its asset_ref component)

table.name: Spatial Component

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_spatial_expression, ordinal)

row.name: part
row.comment: PRESET field names (decision 23): raw_position | latitude | longitude | altitude_m | horizontal_accuracy_m | vertical_accuracy_m | horizontal_speed_kmh | vertical_speed_kmh | horizontal_speed_accuracy_kmh | vertical_speed_accuracy_kmh | heading_deg | heading_accuracy_deg | beam_azimuth_deg | beam_width_deg | zone | easting | northing. Anything accepted; standard names export-projected

row.name: source_field
row.comment: which source column it came from - and, since roles were dropped, what tells a reader WHAT this value is (ZENTRYDATE vs ZEXITDATE)

row.name: raw_value
row.comment: VERBATIM: a geohash = 1 row, lat+lon = 2 rows, DMS = 6 rows

row.name: unit
row.comment: the source unit the preset declared for THIS value (unit: m/s). Per component, not per run: two presets may declare different units for one part

table.comment: Decision 15: one row per contributing source field; accuracy/speed get their structured L1 residence here, canonical numbers at L2

table.name: Temporal Expression

row.name: kind
row.comment: instant | interval | open bound

row.name: referential
row.comment: format / reference system: unix_epoch_s | apple_cfabsolute | iso8601 | excel_serial | local_string | ...

row.name: temporal_source
row.comment: clock mechanism: NTP | internal_clock | ...

table.comment: HEADER only (decision 15): the raw values live in Temporal Component rows; stated_offset is per component; granularity dropped - fuzziness lives in the raw value + the integration method

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid5(id_temporal_expression, ordinal)

row.name: part
row.comment: PRESET field names (decision 23): lower | upper | duration (+ lower_date/lower_time-style splits). Anything accepted; standard names export-projected

row.name: stated_offset
row.comment: decision 25 + R13: the offset the source stated for THIS bound, verbatim TEXT ('+01:00', 'CEST'); NULL = none stated. Decision 9's dual offsets, per bound

row.name: raw_value
row.comment: VERBATIM: date col + time col stay two rows; the integration combines them (datetime_combine method)

row.name: id_spatial_expression
row.comment: derived FROM; UNIQUE = one integration in v1, plural possible later

row.name: method
row.comment: geocoder / cell register / passthrough, with version + reference data

row.name: position_raw
row.comment: the VERBATIM information that allowed latitude_wgs84 / longitude_wgs84, as source_column:value joined by " | " - the evidence behind the derived coordinate. Scoped to what the PRODUCING METHOD read (each declares it via coordinate_inputs), not to the latitude/longitude parts: those coincide only while reprojection is the sole mechanism, and a geocoder reads an address while a cell-register or BSSID lookup reads an identifier. Empty when no coordinate was produced. Nothing in mATLAS parses it

row.name: referential
row.comment: the expression's encoding/CRS, carried here so the derived block reads whole - one row shows what the coordinates are, how they were derived and what the source stated them in, with no join back to L1

row.name: spatial_source
row.comment: the expression's mechanism (GNSS | WiFi | cell | ...), carried here for the same reason. Written once by the integration pass, straight from the expression, so the copy cannot drift

row.name: id_temporal_expression
row.comment: derived FROM; UNIQUE = one integration in v1

row.name: lower_unix_utc_us
row.comment: canonical UTC microseconds

row.name: offset_to_local_hours_lower
row.comment: hours to ADD to lower_unix_utc_us to read it in the case's configured local_zone, DST-resolved AT that instant: a float, the loud 'N/A' when no zone is configured, or NULL when the bound has no instant. NOT the source's own offset (that is temporal_component.stated_offset) and NOT the offset consumed to reach UTC - that older meaning was NULL for every epoch source. Stamped once in integrate_expression, never by a Method

row.name: offset_to_local_hours_upper
row.comment: the same for the upper bound; differs from the lower across a DST transition, which is why it is per bound

row.name: lower_accuracy_us
row.comment: per-bound timing uncertainty (µs): source-stated or the Method's claim

row.name: upper_accuracy_us
row.comment: applied to the upper bound; independent of the lower

row.name: method
row.comment: tz rule / epoch decode / assumed-UTC, with version

row.name: kind
row.comment: the expression's shape (instant | interval | open_lower | open_upper), carried here so the derived block reads whole - the temporal twin of spatial_integration.referential

row.name: referential
row.comment: the format the source expressed the time in (unix_epoch_s | apple_cfabsolute | iso8601 | local_string | ...)

row.name: temporal_source
row.comment: the clock mechanism (NTP | internal_clock | ...). Written once by the integration pass, straight from the expression, so the copy cannot drift

row.name: id_spatial_integration
row.comment: 1:1 with the point; UNIQUE

row.name: s2_cell_id
row.comment: decision 31: signed-int64 LEAF S2 cell, NON-unique (many points per cell), INDEXED. Hierarchy implicit in the id -> range scans; built with s2sphere

table.name: Edit log

row.name: id
row.comment: uuid4 - an audit event (decision 34)

row.name: ordinal
row.comment: decision 41: monotonic UNIQUE journal position - inverse replay in reverse order = full rewind; a rewind appends inverse entries, never erases

row.name: row_id
row.comment: the edited row's id (soft reference across tables)

row.name: edit_kind
row.comment: update | new_row | empty_row - evidence rows only new_row/empty_row (decision 34)

row.name: edited_at
row.comment: ISO-8601 UTC

table.comment: Decision 34: manual-edit audit for the edit panel; L0/L1 evidence never updated in place (new-row only); integration/analysis mutable in place
